text:
Predicates:
LanguageGenerationTask(x) ::: x is a language generation task.
LanguageUnderstandingTask(x) ::: x is a language understanding task.
OutputOf(x, y) ::: the output of task x is y.
TextSequence(y) ::: y is a text sequence.
MachineTranslation(x) ::: x is a machine translation task.

Premises:
∃x (LanguageGenerationTask(x) ∧ OutputOf(x, y) ∧ TextSequence(y)) ::: If the output of a task is a text sequence, then it is a language generation task.
MachineTranslation(x) ::: Machine translation is a natural language processing task.
OutputOf(MachineTranslation, y) ::: The output of machine translation is a text sequence.

Conclusion:
¬(MachineTranslation(x) → LanguageUnderstandingTask(x)) ::: Machine translation is not a language understanding task.
